title: Traffic Signal Symbols
summary: Legend of the symbols used on LADOT traffic signal plans. It covers signal heads, signal standards, mast arms, pedestrian signals and pushbuttons, cabinets, pullboxes, detectors, cameras, poles, trees, fire hydrants and other features, each shown as proposed, existing, and existing to be removed. Footnotes A through F set common conditions such as backplates on all heads and a 15 ft default mast arm length.

title: Steel Signal Standards Types 1, 1A, 8, 8A and 9; RRFB Sign Arm; Foundation Types F-1 and F-8
summary: Group of three LADOT sheets. The first gives structural details for tapered steel pole Types 1, 1A, 8, 8A and 9 (0.1196 in wall, base plate, hand hole, pole top tenon). The second gives the sign arm data and sign sizes for a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (W11-2 and W16-7p). The third gives foundation Types F-1 and F-8 for signal standards and the Type 337 post-top cabinet, with a 36 in by 24 in by 4 in slab at each cabinet door opening in unpaved areas.

sheets.notes:
Standards Type 1, 1A, 8, 8A and 9 (structural design). Sheet 1 of 1.
Details shown: base plate (10 in sq., 9 1/2 in and 8 1/2 in bolt circles, 1 1/4 in x 1 3/4 in slots for anchor bolts), Elevation A, Detail A (weld, 30 degrees max. contact angle, 1.57 T min. and 1.83 T min.), and Detail B (pole top tenon: 4 1/2 in O.D., 4 NPS Std, 4.00 in, 1/4 in plate with 2 in central hole).
T (wall thickness) = 0.1196 in. 3/4 in base plate.
Type 8: 1 ft 8 in tall, 4.5 in O.D. at top, 4.73 in O.D. at base.
Type 8A: 2 ft 4 in tall, 4.5 in O.D. at top, 4.83 in O.D. at base.
Type 9: 7 ft 2 in tall, 4.29 in O.D. at top, 5.25 in O.D. at base.
Type 1: 10 ft 6 in tall, 4.06 in O.D. at top, 5.48 in O.D. at base, foundation see S-52.1, 24 in x 24 in (24 in dia. optional), 3 ft 6 in deep. 2 ft 11.5 in to the top drill pattern: 2 1/4 in dia. hole (drill 1 side only) and two 3/4 in dia. holes (drill through), 4.5 in spacing.
Type 1A: 14 ft 0 in tall, 3.57 in O.D. at top, 5.48 in O.D. at base. Drill pattern 6 ft 5.5 in from the top, same hole sizes, 4.5 in spacing.
3 in x 5 in hand hole reinforced with 1/4 in x 2 in ring welded to outside of pole and 1/8 in cover plate.
0.50 in NC square nut holder with fastener for grounding welded to interior of pole shaft at 180 degrees from hand hole rim.
Notes:
1. All standards shall be tapered steel posts with 0.1196 in wall thickness.
2. Max. taper of posts shall be 0.143 in per foot.

Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon sign arm. Sheet 2 of 4.
Detail B (not to scale): sign arm span 8 ft max.
Detail C (not to scale): clamp (Pelco AB-3004).
Sign arm data: arm span L 8 ft 0 in, fixed end dia. 3.52 in, free end dia. 2.4 in, gage 11, degree rise 0.50.
Sign arm material data:
Sign arm shaft: A595 Gr. A, min. yield 55 ksi.
Clamp: A572, 55 ksi.
Sign arm connection bolts: A325, 55 ksi.
Hardware coating: hot dip zinc.
Finish notes: system galvanized (GV). Base coat hot dip galvanized to ASTM A123. Prime coat none. Color none. Finish coat none.
Sign dimensions, conventional road (single lane / multi-lane):
W11-2 Pedestrian: 30x30* / 36x36.
W16-7p Downward diagonal arrow: 24x12 / 24x12.
* The minimum size required for diamond-shaped warning signs facing traffic on multi-lane conventional roads shall be 36x36 per MUTCD section 2C.04.

Foundation Type F-1 and F-8. Sheet 1 of 1.
Notes:
1. Type F-1: 2 in nominal size conduit, unless otherwise specified.
2. Type F-8 and Type F-8A: 3 in nominal size conduit, unless otherwise specified.
3. Unless otherwise specified, in unpaved areas a 36 in x 24 in x 4 in slab shall be provided for each door opening in the case of a model 336 cabinet.
4. On Type F-8 and Type F-8A, ground rod shall be installed in controller pullbox.
Top view: 4 in thick slab, 24 in wide, 36 in + 24 in + 36 in long, 8 1/2 in bolt circle, 45 degree bolt spacing, curb face shown.
Section: base plate 10 in x 10 in x 3/4 in. Anchor bolts 1 in dia. x 3 ft 0 in, thread bottom 6 in (2 nuts and 2 washers, total 4 required per bolt). Anchor plate 10 in x 10 in x 3/4 in. Anchor bolt threaded top 8 in and galvanized 12 in. 2 in min. to 3 in max. mortar. After plumbing the standard, place mortar all around bolts and finish with slope ranging from 45 to 90 degrees including drain holes. 3 in x 5 in reinforced hand hole and cover. #8 green bonding wire. 0.50 in NC square nut holder with fastener for grounding welded to interior of pole shaft at 180 degrees from hand hole rim. 4 in min. topping. Foundation 24 in x 24 in (24 in dia. optional), 42 in deep, 14 in min. to conduit, 3 in min. below anchor plate. 36 in from curb face.

title: Type 337 Post-Top Mounted Cabinet
summary: Shows a typical installation of a Type 337 post-top mounted signal cabinet on a Type 8 shaft with a slip fitter and a Type F-8 foundation. The cabinet is mounted with its doors perpendicular to the curb and swinging toward the curb. The shaft is set 36 in from the curb face with a 3 in conduit at 14 in min.

sheets.notes:
Type 337 post-top mounted cabinet. Sheet 1 of 1.
Detail: door openings on Type 337 PTM cabinet shown relative to the curb face.
Typical cabinet installation (Type 337 post-top mounted cabinet): slip fitter, Type 8 shaft, Foundation Type F-8, 3 in conduit.
Dimensions: 36 in from curb face to shaft, 14 in min. conduit depth.
Note: Type 337 PTM cabinet to be mounted with doors perpendicular to curb and doors swing towards curb. See detail upper left.

title: Standard, Type 16 (Signal Mast Arm Pole) and Foundation, Type F-2
summary: Two LADOT sheets. The first gives the Type 16 tapered steel signal standard with a mast arm of 15 ft (max. 20 ft), a minimum signal mounting height of 17 ft 6 in, pole and arm schedules, base plate and hand hole details. The second gives Foundation Type F-2, a 32 in square footing 48 in deep plus 4 in topping with 4 anchor bolts on an 11 1/2 in bolt circle.

sheets.notes:
Standard, Type 16. Pole and signal arm details.
Signal arm projected length 15 ft 0 in unless otherwise noted (max. 20 ft). Traffic signal mounting height 17 ft 6 in min. Pole height 18 ft 0 in.
Provide removable rain-tight cap. 18 in x 66 in sign. See Detail "A".
Dimensions at the pole: 7 ft 6 in, 11 ft 3 in, 15 ft 6 in, 17 ft 6 in, 18 ft 0 in. Foundation Type F-2 (S-52.2), 32 in x 32 in x (48 in + 4 in topping), 560-C-3250 concrete. Anchor bolt 1 1/8 in x 40 in, ASTM A307. Top 3 in of foundation to be poured level with sidewalk except on structures. 36 in from curb.
Detail "A" (not to scale): tap pole plate for hex. head cap screw ASTM A325, 3/4 in-10 x 1 3/4 in long, total 3. 1 in dia. chased outlet for electrical conductors. 2 1/4 in drill, one side, opposite quadrant of mast arm. 3/4 in drill thru 2 holes (typ. 2 places). Bar 2 in x 1/4 in x 0 ft 5 in. 10 ga. plate 1/4 in, 7 ga. plate 5/16 in. Note: dimensions shown here apply to both the post and signal arm plate.
Pole base plate (no scale): 4 in x 6 1/2 in handhole reinforced with No. 3 gage ring 1 1/2 in wide welded to outside of pole. Cover of 10 gage plate. Locate in opposite quadrant of mast arm. Bar 1 in x 1/4 in backing ring, tack weld to plate. 11 1/2 in bolt circle on axis of mast arm. 11 1/2 in sq. plate, hole dia. = 5 3/4 in, R = 1 1/2 in, 1 3/8 in x 1 1/2 in slot for anchor bolt.
Pole schedule: round tapered steel pole, height 18.0 ft, gage 10 GA., min. O.D. 7 3/4 in base and 5 1/4 in top, signal arm length 15 to 20 ft.
Signal arm data (1): projected length 15 ft 0 in, 10 GA., min. O.D. at pole 4.6 in, mounting height 22.3 ft. 18 ft 0 in, 10 GA., 5.2 in, 23.3 ft. 20 ft 0 in, 7 GA., 5.0 in, 23.3 ft.
Notes:
(1) Round tapered steel tube with maximum taper of 0.15 in per foot. End section O.D. of 2 3/8 in for mounting hardware. Standard 2 in pipe extensions of 3 ft 0 in max. length may be used at the option of the manufacturer.
(2) 4 anchor bolts each base plate. Length indicated does not include required 4 in 90 degree bend. Each anchor bolt is threaded 6 in at the top and is furnished with 2 nuts and 2 washers. One anchor bolt bonded to conduit.
1. Pole and signal arm shall be fabricated from sheet steel conforming to the specifications of ASTM Designation A611 Grade C, or ASTM Designation A570 Grade C.
2. All welding shall conform to AWS D2.0 "Specifications for Welded Highway and Railway Bridges."
3. All structural steel shall conform to ASTM designation A36, except as otherwise shown.
Notes, continued:
1. Alternative details approved by the Engineer may be substituted for the arm connections and configurations shown.
2. Fabricators electing to use larger than min. arm diameters must adjust the details as required to permit solid seating of cap screws.
3. In lieu of the torque requirements for HS bolts, cap screws shall be tightened by the turn-of-nut method 1/6 turn from snug tight condition. No washer will be required.
4. Only one signal head may be mounted on each signal arm.
5. All metal parts shall be galvanized after fabrication.
6. All arms shall be bent to the approximate configuration shown.

Foundation, Type F-2. Sheet 1 of 1.
Plan: 32 in sq. footing, 8 1/8 in sq. base plate, 11 1/2 in bolt circle, anchor bolts at 45 degrees. 36 in from curb.
Section: minimum topping 4 in, 14 in min. to conduit, footing depth 48 in, 6 in min. Anchor bolts 1 1/8 in x 40 in x 4 in (2 nuts and 2 washers required per bolt). Bonding strap or wire. Bushing.
Notes:
1. Use 1 in galvanized conduit for street lighting and 2 in schedule 80 PVC conduit for traffic signal unless otherwise specified.
2. Conduit stubs from foundation shall be in the direction of the nearest corresponding pullbox unless otherwise specified.
3. Topping shall be considered as a part of the foundation.

title: 100 MPH Poles (Sheet 1 of 2)
summary: Gives the pole, mast arm and cast-in-drilled-hole (CIDH) pile foundation data for LADOT 100 mph signal poles. A schedule lists each pole type by standard height (17 ft, 18.5 ft or 30 ft), mast arm length (15 ft to 65 ft), minimum signal spacing, pile diameter and depth, cage size, anchor bolts and base plate size. Poles are fabricated to the 2006 Caltrans Standard Plans.

sheets.notes:
100 MPH Poles, sheet 1 of 2.
Section A-A, cast-in-drilled-hole (CIDH) pile foundation: 2 in clearance, #8 total 10 bars, #4 at 6 in or #4 spiral at 6 in pitch with 1 ft 6 in lap at splice and 135 degree hook at terminations.
Elevation: 36 in offset. 0.50 in NC square nut holder with fastener for grounding welded to interior of pole shaft at 180 degrees from hand hole rim. #8 green bonding wire. 4 in x 6 1/2 in hand hole reinforced with ring welded to outside of pole, see note 2, 1/8 in cover plate. Anchor bolt threaded top 8 in and galvanized 12 in. 1 in plus or minus 1/4 in. 2 in min. to 3 in max. mortar. After plumbing standard, place mortar all around bolts and finish with slope ranging from 45 to 90 degrees including drain holes. 18 in min. depth. Traffic signal conduit (2 in). Street lighting conduit (1 in). Anchor bolts (2 nuts and 2 washers required per bolt), total 4. Type 560-C-3250 concrete. Reinforcing cage with 3 in clearance. Base plate dimension C with bolt circle, slot size 2 3/8 in (2 5/8 in for 60-5-100 and 61-5-100), 1 1/2 in and 3 in edge dimensions as shown.
Schedule (type, standard height, mast arm length, F min. spacing):
16-3-100: 18.5 ft; 17-3-100: 30 ft. Mast arm 15 ft or 20 ft, F = 8 ft.
18-4-100: 17 ft; 19-4-100: 30 ft. Mast arm 25 ft or 30 ft, F = 12 ft.
23-4-100: 17 ft; 24-4-100: 30 ft. Mast arm 35 ft, F = 14 ft.
26-4-100: 30 ft; 27-4-100: 17 ft. Mast arm 40 ft or 45 ft, F = 15 ft.
28-5-100: 17 ft; 29-5-100: 30 ft. Mast arm 50 ft or 55 ft, F1 = 15 ft, F2 = 12 ft.
60-5-100: 17 ft; 61-5-100: 30 ft. Mast arm 60 ft or 65 ft, F1 = 15 ft, F2 = 12 ft.
CIDH pile: diameter 36 in, cage diameter 32 in. Depth 9 ft with cage depth 8 ft 6 in for the lighter types, 9 ft 2 in with cage depth 8 ft 8 in for types 28-5-100 and 29-5-100, 16 ft with cage depth 15 ft 6 in for types 60-5-100 and 61-5-100.
Anchor bolts 2 in dia. x 42 in x 6 in (2 1/4 in dia. x 60 in x 6 in for types 60-5-100 and 61-5-100). Bolt circle 18 in (21 in for types 28-5-100 and 29-5-100, 23 in for types 60-5-100 and 61-5-100), with * for the first two types: fabricate and install with 18 in bolt circle. Plate dimension C: 18 in, 21 in or 23 in to match.
Notes:
1. Fabrication of the standards shall conform to the 2006 State of California Department of Transportation Standard Plans.
2. Hand hole reinforcement ring shall be 1/4 in x 2 in for 0.1196 in to 0.2391 in thick poles, 3/8 in x 2 in for 0.3125 in thick poles.
3. Base plate to be fabricated as shown.
4. Luminaire arm length per street lighting sheet.
5. Standard to be pre-drilled as shown.
6. Attach stamped metal tag above hand hole on pole and on mast arm (minimum 1/4 in height numbers, see sheet 2).

title: 100 MPH Poles (Sheet 2 of 2): Side Mount Indications Drill Detail
summary: Shows how a 100 mph signal pole is drilled for side-mounted signal indications and tagged. A hole pattern on the side opposite the mast arm sets 9 in spacing, and signal heads mount at 11 ft 3 in and 7 ft 6 in above grade. Metal tags give the pole type, load case, design wind velocity, mast arm length and height.

sheets.notes:
100 MPH Poles, sheet 2 of 2. Side Mount Indications Drill Detail.
Elevation: mast arm length measured from the pole to the outermost signal head. Signal head spacing F1 and F2 along the arm. Standard height shown at the pole. Side-mounted signal indications at 11 ft 3 in and 7 ft 6 in above grade. Hand hole near the base. CIDH foundation, see detail on sheet 1.
Side view opposite of mast arm: two 3/4 in dia. holes (drill through) and one 2 1/4 in dia. hole (drill 1 side only), spaced 4 1/2 in and 9 in as shown.
Metal tag on mast arm: LA-XX-X-XXX-XX, reading Type, Load case, Design wind velocity, Actual mast arm length (ft).
Metal tag at hand hole: LA-XX-X-XXX-XX-XX, reading Type, Load case, Design wind velocity, Max. mast arm length (ft), Height (ft).

title: Foundation Details (Sheet 4 of 4)
summary: Shows a 36 in diameter round concrete footing, 60 in deep with 4 in min. topping, for a signal or street light pole with an 11 1/2 in bolt circle. It lists the rebar, anchor bolts, 1 in street light conduit and 2 in traffic signal conduit. Conduit stubs run toward the nearest pullbox, and the bolt circle must be coordinated with the light pole base plate.

sheets.notes:
Foundation details. Sheet 4 of 4.
Plan: 36 in dia. footing (min. 3000 psi concrete), 11 1/2 in bolt circle, 8 1/8 in sq. base, anchor bolts at 45 degrees.
Section: 36 in from curb. Bonding strap or wire. Bushing. 4 in min. topping. 2 3/4 in. 14 in min. to conduit. 60 in footing depth. 6 in min. 36 in dia. 3 in clearance. 2 in clearance. (8) #10 long reinforced. #4 ties at 9 in OC typ. (provide (2) ties at 2 in OC at top). 1 in dia. street light conduit. 2 in dia. traffic signal conduit. Anchor bolts 1 1/8 in x 40 in x 4 in (2 nuts and 2 washers required per bolt) (ASTM F1554 Gr 55 bolts).
Notes:
1. Use 1 in galvanized conduit for street lighting and 2 in schedule 80 PVC conduit for traffic signal unless otherwise specified.
2. Conduit stubs from foundation shall be in the direction of the nearest corresponding pullbox unless otherwise specified.
3. Topping shall be considered as a part of the foundation.
4. Coordinate bolt circle with light pole base plate prior to anchor bolt installation.
5. Coordinate conduit size and placement with electrical prior to installation.

title: Temporary Signal for Type 1 Standard
summary: Shows a temporary traffic signal on a Type 1 standard held down by a 36 in square steel platform with four 5 gallon cans filled with concrete, locked on with steel coil chain. Heads are 12 in to match the permanent heads being replaced. The standard is set level on slopes greater than 1/2 in rise per foot by grading or wood shims.

sheets.notes:
Temporary signal for Type 1 standard. Sheet 1 of 1.
Use 12 in heads corresponding to permanent heads being replaced.
Platform (top view detail, not to scale): 36 in x 36 in. 36 in sq. x 1/4 in thick steel platform, hot dip galvanized per ASTM 123. Type 1 base with 4 1 in dia. x 3-1/2 in bolts and nuts with 2 washers for each bolt. 3/8 in dia. steel coil chain tied to each 5 gal. block and locked around the Type 1 standard. 5 gal. can filled with concrete, four cans are required, spaced as shown.
Platform (bottom view detail, not to scale): 36 in x 36 in. 2 in high x 1/4 in thick perimeter lip resting on ground. 1-3/4 in x 1-3/4 in x 1/4 in steel angle brackets welded to plate. 4 holes at 1-1/4 in dia. 8-1/2 in dia. bolt circle. 1 in x 1 in notches for cable.
Weight block (not to scale): 5 gal. can filled with concrete, min. weight 90 lbs. 1/2 in dia. steel rod embedded 9 in deep. Block 12 in wide x 14 in high, 4 in rod width, 3 in rod projection.
Type 1 standard (not to scale): street name sign, pedestrian signal, 3/8 in dia. steel coil chain tied to each 5 gal. block and locked around the Type 1 standard. 5 gal. can filled with concrete. Base assembly. "LADOT" or contractor name embossed or welded on at least two sides. 2 in lip. 1 in x 1 in notch for cable.
For slopes greater than 1/2 in rise per foot, temporary standard to be set level through the use of grading or wood shims.

title: Fittings, Typical, Terminal Compartment and Pole Plate Mounting
summary: Shows typical fittings for mounting a signal terminal compartment, side mount or post-top mount, on a signal standard, along with the pole plate for side mountings. It lists the bolts, washers, lock ring, slip fitter threads and teeth counts used. Construction, material and finish painting follow the State of California Standard Specifications.

sheets.notes:
Fittings, typical, terminal compartment and pole plate mounting.
Terminal compartment, side mount: 3/4 in-11 N.C. hex. hd. bolt with lock washer and flat washer, hot dip galvanized. Flat washer and curved washer. Cover. Special tee. 72 teeth. Cable guide, omit on cover. Lock ring. Pipe threads. 5/16-16 N.C. x 7/8 in sq. hd. cup pt. set screw, hot dip galvanized (6 req.). 4 in (min. thread).
Terminal compartment, post-top mount: 72 teeth upper plate. Washer curved to fit standard. Detail "A": 1 1/2 in pipe thread. Detail A: flat washer, 5/8 in-11 N.C. hex. hd. bolt, hot dip galvanized, nut, washer, 3/4 in lockwasher and 7/8 in flat washer, signal standard.
Pole plate for side mountings.
Note: Construction, material and finish painting shall conform to "Standard Specifications" (latest edition), Dept. of Transportation, State of California.

title: Visor, 12 in Diameter, Beveled
summary: Shows the 12 in diameter beveled signal visor, with the left-beveled version drawn and an ear detail. A right-beveled visor is made by beveling the opposite side. Other details are in LADOT Purchase Specification #92-061-06.

sheets.notes:
Visor, 12 in dia., beveled.
Left beveled visor shown. See ear detail. Bevel opposite side for right beveled visor.
Note: Refer to LADOT Purchase Specification #92-061-06 for all other details.

The sheets cover the long visor (8 in x 18 in and 12 in x 27 in full circle), the tunnel or pigeon visor (8 in x 8 in and 12 in x 12 in), and the standard full circle visor (8 in and 12 in). Each refers to the ear detail on S-76.3 and to LADOT Purchase Specification #92-061-06.

sheets.notes:
Long visor, 8 in and 12 in diameter, full circle (S-76.7).
Long visor, 8 in x 18 in full circle. Not to scale. See ear detail on Std. Dwg. No. S-76.3.
Long visor, 12 in x 27 in full circle. Not to scale. See ear detail on Std. Dwg. No. S-76.3.
Note: Refer to LADOT Purchase Specification #92-061-06 for all other details.

Pigeon (tunnel) visor, 8 in and 12 in diameter (S-76.8).
Visor, 8 in x 8 in tunnel. Not to scale. See ear detail on Std. Dwg. No. S-76.3.
Visor, 12 in x 12 in tunnel. Not to scale. See ear detail on Std. Dwg. No. S-76.3.
Note: Refer to LADOT Purchase Specification #92-061-06 for all other details.

Visor, 8 in and 12 in diameter, full circle (S-76.9).
Visor, 8 in full circle. Not to scale. See ear detail on Std. Dwg. No. S-76.3.
Visor, 12 in full circle. Not to scale. See ear detail on Std. Dwg. No. S-76.3.
Note: Refer to LADOT Purchase Specification #92-061-06 for all other details.

title: Pushbutton, Installation
summary: Shows how a pedestrian pushbutton is installed on steel and concrete signal standards, with tapped holes and a typical arrangement at the curb. Pushbutton mounting height is adjusted to 42 in above the surface pedestrians are expected to use to reach the button, with a typical 3 ft 6 in height shown.

sheets.notes:
Pushbutton, installation. Sheet 1 of 1.
No. 7 drill, 1/4 in-20 N.C. tap, 2 holes. Parallel to crosswalk. Steel standards. Standard inserts for concrete standards, tapped 1/4 in-20 N.C., for which intended. Concrete standards. Curb. Typical arrangement. Pushbutton. 3 ft 6 in typical.
Adjust pushbutton mounting height to 42 in above the surface pedestrians are expected to access pushbutton from.

title: Pushbutton
summary: Shows the LADOT pedestrian pushbutton assembly in post-top and side mounting on signal standards, with push button station housing and 2 in diameter pushbuttons. It shows the pedestrian signal instruction messages, such as Walk, Don't Start, Flashing Don't Cross, and Time Remaining. Mounting hardware is four 8-32 x 3/4 in screws, and construction follows LADOT material specifications 92-052-02 and 92-053-02.

sheets.notes:
Pushbutton. Sheet 1 of 1.
Post-top mounting (see S-51.7 for installation): back of casting shaped to fit 2 1/2 in dia. standard. Sign text: Start Crossing, Watch for Vehicles, Flashing: if started finish crossing, Time remaining to finish crossing, Don't Start, Steady: Don't cross, Timer, Push button to cross.
Side mounting (see S-72.0A for installation): back of casting shaped to fit curvature of standard. Same sign text.
Type 5 and 6 standards only, side mounting (see S-72.0A for installation).
Notes:
1. Pedestrian pushbuttons: see Standard Drawings S-73.0 and S-73.1. Bicycle pushbuttons: see Standard Drawings S-72.2.
2. Mounting hardware consists of four (4) 8-32 x 3/4 in long.
Housing: construction, materials and finish painting shall conform to LADOT material specification 92-052-02 or latest version.
Assembly: construction, materials and finish painting shall conform to LADOT material specification 92-053-02 or latest version. Pushbuttons shall be 2 in in diameter.

title: Pedestrian Pushbutton Sign, Non-Actuated
summary: Shows the pedestrian pushbutton sign used for non-actuated crossings. The sign is .063 aluminum, powder coated with black legend on a white background and orange hand and timer symbols. The sign text covers Start Crossing, Watch for Vehicles, Flashing, Time Remaining, Don't Start and Steady Don't Cross, with a Timer symbol. Four 1/4 in inside diameter mounting holes are shown.

sheets.notes:
Pedestrian pushbutton sign, non-actuated. Sheet 1 of 1.
1/4 in inside diameter, 4 places (typ.).
Sign text: Start Crossing, Watch for Vehicles, Flashing: if started finish crossing, Time remaining to finish crossing, Don't Start, Steady: Don't Cross, Timer.
Dimensions as shown: R = 1/2 in corner radius, 4 in and 5 in.
Notes:
1. Sign shall be .063 aluminum.
2. Powder coated with black legend on white background and orange hand and timer symbols.

title: Bicycle Detector; Light Rail Train (LRT) Track Detector Loop
summary: Two LADOT detector sheets. The first (S-70.1D) shows bicycle detector loops. Case I is a pair of 3 ft loops for bicycle only (bike lane) and Case II is a pair of 6 ft loops for bicycle and vehicle, with winding details and saw cut sections. The second (S-70.4A, sheet 3 of 3) shows the preformed 30 in LRT track detector loop and the Type A LRT detector handhole.

sheets.notes:
Bicycle detector. Sheet 1 of 1.
Winding detail (not to scale): loops 1 and 2. Twisted clockwise (at least 2 turns per ft.) into a pair. To pullbox. Wire pairs 1, 2, 3, 4.
Case I (bicycle only): loop 1 and loop 2 each 3 ft, spaced 3 ft apart. Pullbox 3 ft 0 in max. from the curb face.
Case II (bicycle and vehicle): loop 1 and loop 2 each 6 ft, spaced 8 ft apart. Pullbox 3 ft 0 in max. from the curb face.
Direction of traffic flow shown.
Saw cut sections:
Sect. A-A: 3/8 in wide, 3.5 in deep*.
Sect. B-B: 1/2 in wide, 5 in deep*.
Sect. C-C: 3/8 in wide, 5 in deep*.
Sect. D-D: 1/2 in max. wide, 5 in deep*, 8 wires max. per 1/2 in sawcut.
Sect. E-E: 1/2 in max. wide, 5 in deep*.
* Depth of slot not to exceed depth of pavement.
Notes:
1. Install four (4) complete alternating turns of loop wires, unless otherwise specified.
2. For stub-out and conduit details refer to page 2 of S-70.1A.
3. See LADOT Material Specification No. 92-081-05 or latest revision.
4. Use Case I loops for bike lane installations. Use Case II loops when vehicular loops are intended to detect bicycles.
5. An octagonal shaped loop or other non-round shaped loop may be used instead of the round loop with prior LADOT approval.
6. Same winding pattern to be used in both loops for Case I with 1 pair from each loop leading to the pullbox.
7. Loops installed in bike lanes with parking shall be placed with the near edge of the loop 1 ft to the right of the bike lane delineation line, unless otherwise specified.
8. Loops installed in bike lanes adjacent to the roadside without parking shall be centered in the bike lane, or between the gutter and the bike delineation line, unless otherwise specified.
9. Any LADOT approved non-round shaped loops must conform to all other specifications shown on this standard drawing.

Light Rail Train (LRT) track detector loop. Sheet 3 of 3 (S-70.4A).
LRT preformed loop details (cont'd).
Preformed loop: 30 in diameter. 3/4 in O.D. asphalt rubber filled hydraulic hose. Expansion joint. CVCC tee. 3/8 in O.D. asphalt rubber filled hydraulic hose to Type A handhole. Twisted tail.
Winding details (not to scale): twisted clockwise (at least 2 turns per ft.) into a pair, to Type A handhole. Pairs 1 and 2.
Type 'A' LRT detector handhole:
Throat dia. 9 in. 4 in min. 12 in total depth, 11-3/8 in inside depth, 8 in min. 6 in min. below the box. 10-3/8 in box width, 1 in wall. 3 in min. around the handhole. Cast iron frame and cover (cover 11-1/8 in, frame 14-1/4 in, marked LADOT). Loop sealant. Ballast, PCC or hot AC to match adjacent roadbed material. Precast reinforced concrete box. Cables of shielded loop conductor pairs. Portland cement concrete. Conduit to termination pullbox, 2 in Schedule 80 PVC (30 in deep). Clean, crushed rock sump.
Notes:
1. Splices shall only be made in the handhole.
2. Splices shall be soldered and water proofed.
